prompt.project_info: Create a realistic portrait of an original approved adult model in a softly lit cozy bedroom.
prompt.main_subject: An original approved adult blonde woman with long straight hair, natural makeup, glossy lips, and a relaxed confident expression stands facing the camera with one hand on her hip. Preserve the reference outfit: a fitted pink crop top layered over contrasting thin straps and dark purple lingerie-style bottoms.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical standing portrait, subject centered near the bed, white bedding and pillows against the headboard, bedside table, warm lamp, minimal cozy bedroom interior, and a feminine silhouette with form-fitting wardrobe fit.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm bedside-lamp ambient light with soft shadows and smooth highlights, calm evening atmosphere, gentle pink and purple color contrast.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic photography, vertical portrait framing, 50mm lens perspective, shallow natural depth of field, visible skin and fabric texture, restrained color grading, no artificial HDR look.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Realistic vertical indoor fashion portrait of an original approved adult blonde woman with long straight hair, natural makeup, and a relaxed confident expression standing in a minimal cozy bedroom with one hand on her hip. Preserve the reference outfit: a fitted pink crop top layered over contrasting thin straps and dark purple lingerie-style bottoms. White bedding, pillows, bedside table, and warm bedside lamps create a calm evening atmosphere. Soft shadows, smooth highlights, natural skin and fabric texture, 50mm portrait perspective, gentle pink and purple palette.
